description_en: This eleven-bayed Pinchẽ Phalcā is of an exceptional length. It is located at Pinchẽ tola and is owned and administered by the local community (without aguthi). Anotherphalcāand a small temple are located directly north of this monument. Pinchẽ Phalcā houses a statue of Gaṇeśa and has also been furnished with an inscription. A beam (dhahmā) from a former Matsyendranāth chariot is placed in front of the Phalcā, reaching along its whole length. Pinchẽ Phalcā'srear wall is partly attached to residential houses. In 2003, its roof and its dwarf storey were renewed with the use of historical materials. Both ends of thePhalcā project into the road, and the five bays on its left are partially closed off by a knee-high balustrade. All of the monument's late 17th century columns and capital-brackets have been preserved.
description_ne: पिन्छेँमा रहेको ११ वटा कवल भएको यो फल्चा स्थानीय वासिन्दाहरूको स्वामित्वमा रहेको छ र यससँग सम्बन्धित कुनै गुठी छैन । यसको उत्तरपट्टि अर्को फल्चा र एउटा सानो मन्दिर रहेको छ । यस फल्चाभित्र गणेशको मूर्ति र एउटा अभिलेख रहेको छ । फल्चाको अगाडि मत्स्येन्द्रनाथको रथको पुरानो धमा राखिएको छ । फल्चा व्यक्तिगत घरसँग जोडिएको छ । सन् २००३ मा पुनः प्रयोग गर्न मिल्ने पुरानो सामग्रीको प्रयोग गरेर फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।

historical_events.event_description: One inscriptions in this Phalcā makes reference to the construction year. However, the inscription is mostly illegible and thus, the date is unreadable.
Pinchẽ Phalcā was renovated by Lalitpur Metropolitan City and the local community.

The letters of this inscription are illegible. The symbol of a sword can be seen above the inscription, whilst two kneeling devotees or donors have been carved into the lower part. They are shown performing a gesture of greeting.
